name: Claudia Dzienny
bio: Claudia Dzienny (née Pickering) is an Australian actress, writer and director.

credits.title: Zombucha!
credits.overview: After one particularly catastrophic day at their respective workplaces, busy professionals Maddie and Leo find themselves both unemployed. Dreaming of a fresh start but needing reliable income to support the family they hope to start together, the couple have a chance encounter with Kai, a smouldering kombucha artisan

credits.title: Sydney Stories
credits.overview: An anthology of award winning short films, this feature show cases an international cast and crew, shooting all over New South Wales, telling all kinds of stories.

credits.title: Zombie Bro
credits.overview: A young girl must enlist her juvenile father to help save the town from her biting brother. Whilst she's trying to save the town, she must go through school life whilst hiding her brother's true form

credits.title: Wanderbust
credits.overview: While backpacking in Australia, Jac attempts to hide her pregnancy from her best mate Hazel for fear of becoming 'redundant', but their assumptions land them in hot water with a stranger.

credits.title: The Hitchhiker
credits.overview: A wild, prosecco-fulled road trip takes an interesting turn with the pick-up of a hitchhiker.

credits.title: Frisky
credits.overview: Two twenty-somethings move to San Francisco to chase their career, but end up chasing tail instead.

credits.title: Winning Formula
credits.overview: While backpacking around America, two Aussie girls find themselves deep in turtle racing debt. They devise crafty schemes to earn money any way they can while unwittingly becoming tangled in a dark mystery surrounding their family's past.
